title: human-synapse-bouton-lab: Formally Verified Human Synaptic Bouton Biophysics, Stochastic Nanocolumn Simulator, and 11-Discipline Open Hard Problems Framework
description: Full-stack multi-language (Lean 4.35.0, Rust, TypeScript, Python) scientific repository with 24 sorry-free zero-Classical.choice formal biophysical invariants (26 concrete witnesses + 6 adversarial counterexample checks across 6 independent kernels in CI), a 50-digit exact reference oracle, 1,000-case cross-language differential verification, a pre-registered 30-seed Monte Carlo experiment (including honest refutation of H3 at 40 Hz), interactive WebGL 3D workbench + live Lean Proof Blueprint DAG, and two AMS-LaTeX white papers with an honest 1,900-problem Mega-Atlas crosswalk.
notes: Code and Lean 4.35.0 proofs are licensed under Apache-2.0; manuscripts, figures, blueprint, datasets, and simulation videos are licensed under CC-BY-4.0. Independent research preprint; not externally journal peer-reviewed. Human CRediT roles: Conceptualization, Methodology, Formal analysis, Validation, Writing - review & editing. AI tools (Antigravity / Google DeepMind) assisted with multi-language software engineering, Lean tactic drafting, and LaTeX typesetting; all proofs are independently certified by Lean 4.35.0 and five external kernels.
